metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 1986 · Crocodile Dundee
metas.description: An American reporter travels to the Australian outback to meet eccentric poacher Mick "Crocodile" Dundee and invites him to New York City, where he comes face-to-face with the complexities of modern life.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.7 · 1988 · Crocodile Dundee II
metas.description: Australian outback expert protects his New York love from gangsters who've followed her down under.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.9 · 2001 · Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles
metas.description: Australian Outback adventurer Mick "Crocodile" Dundee travels to Los Angeles with his young son while his longtime companion suspects foul play at a movie studio.
